name: spring-tools
description: Spring Tools Language Server as an MCP server — Spring Boot diagnostics with fix playbooks, bean/endpoint/architecture insight, version and release information, plus a Spring review agent. Operates standalone without requiring JDT Language Server and watches the workspace for changes. On first run, downloads the language server JAR (checksum-verified) from cdn.spring.io and launches it as a local Java process; requires Java 21+ on PATH.
